description: Source code for the Breakpad crash reporting integration on iOS, including crash dump handling, exception handling, and configuration management.

classes.name: Breakpad
classes.description: Main class managing crash dump handling, configuration, and reporting.

classes.name: ProtectedMemoryLocker
classes.description: Utility class for thread-safe access to protected memory regions.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Factory method to instantiate a Breakpad object with parameters.

methods.name: SetKeyValue
methods.description: Sets a key-value pair in the crash report configuration.

methods.name: KeyValue
methods.description: Retrieves the value for a given key from configuration.

methods.name: RemoveKeyValue
methods.description: Removes a key-value pair from configuration.

methods.name: CrashReportsToUpload
methods.description: Lists crash report files pending upload.

methods.name: NextCrashReportToUpload
methods.description: Gets the path to the next crash report to upload.

methods.name: NextCrashReportConfiguration
methods.description: Reads configuration data for the next crash report.

methods.name: UploadReportWithConfiguration
methods.description: Uploads a crash report with specific configuration.

methods.name: UploadData
methods.description: Uploads arbitrary crash data with a name and server parameters.

methods.name: HandleNetworkResponse
methods.description: Handles server response after crash report upload.

methods.name: GenerateReport
methods.description: Generates a crash report and configuration data.

methods.name: HandleMinidump
methods.description: Processes a minidump after a crash.

methods.name: HandleUncaughtException
methods.description: Handles uncaught NSException by generating a minidump.
